issue.title: Agent-closed beads stand out in the Context card
issue.description: When a SASE agent closes a bead, that agent's Main-deck Context card lists the bead in SASE CONTEXT › ARTIFACTS › Beads with an unmistakable CLOSED pill. The close is credited to the agent that actually closed it (never the bead's creator), stays visible even when the agent touched many other beads, and reads as one feature across the card and `sase bead touched`.

issue.title: Close attribution and close facts in the touch index (sase-core)
issue.description: core: stamp issue_closed events with the acting closer plus a durable closed_by payload field, credit closes in the touch-index reducer (with legacy same-instant note recovery), add a per-touch close record with resolution/reason/standing, and bump the index schema.

issue.title: Python close actor, facade, merge, glyph precedence, and CLI parity
issue.description: plumbing: move the sase-core pin, make `sase bead close` always pass the acting agent, parse the new close record through the facade into BeadTouchEntry, promote closed above created in the shared glyph precedence, and expose the record in `sase bead touched --json`.

issue.title: CLOSED pill rendering, visibility guarantee, and goldens (TUI)
issue.description: render: paint agent-closed rows with a green check, a capped CLOSED pill, resolution and reopened-since states, closed-reason precedence, a lane-header closed count, and closure-first visible-row selection, then cover it with unit tests and new PNG goldens.
